title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: who can search, hold and delete organisational content, and what it costs
summary: The documented controls, licensing statements and limits are supported by Microsoft sources. The page explicitly identifies the conflicting Microsoft guidance on premium administrator licensing, purge permissions and deletion limits rather than presenting either account as settled.

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery identifies, preserves, reviews and exports electronic content for investigations and legal cases.
claims.quote: Use eDiscovery to identify, preserve, collect, review, analyze, and export content that's responsive to your organization's internal and external investigations.

claims.claim: Cases are the organizing unit of the eDiscovery workflow.
claims.quote: In eDiscovery, cases are the primary component of the eDiscovery workflow.

claims.claim: A case contains the searches, holds and review sets related to an investigation.
claims.quote: An eDiscovery case contains all searches, holds, and review sets related to a specific investigation.

claims.claim: Each case has its own membership.
claims.quote: You can also assign members to a case to control who can access the case and view the contents of the case.

claims.claim: An eDiscovery search can cover Exchange, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams, Microsoft 365 Groups and Viva Engage together.
claims.quote: You can search mailboxes and sites in the same eDiscovery search, and then export the search results.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions are stored as items in the user's Exchange Online mailbox.
claims.quote: Each Microsoft 365 Copilot interaction is stored in the user's Exchange Online mailbox as an individual message-class item

claims.claim: Copilot interactions can be searched in eDiscovery.
claims.quote: After you create a case, create an eDiscovery search for the AI application data that you want to delete.

claims.claim: Copilot interactions stored in mailboxes can be preserved by an eDiscovery hold.
claims.quote: Place a hold on the Exchange mailboxes and OneDrive accounts of people you're investigating in the case.

claims.claim: Copilot interactions can be exported.
claims.quote: When these items appear in eDiscovery search results, review sets, or exports (PST files, individual messages, or Microsoft Graph)

claims.claim: Microsoft retired the classic eDiscovery experiences on 31 August 2025.
claims.quote: Microsoft retired all classic eDiscovery experiences on August 31, 2025.

claims.claim: The current eDiscovery experience is in the Microsoft Purview portal.
claims.quote: If your organization isn't hosted by 21Vianet, use the guidance for the new eDiscovery experience in the Microsoft Purview portal.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated that the AI item-class table is updated for every new Copilot feature.
claims.quote: Searched: eDiscovery Copilot AI data item class table updated each new feature meeting memory. Read edisc-search-copilot-data and returned excerpts on memory, Copilot data protection and release notes; found item classes but no commitment to update the table for every feature.

claims.claim: The permissions page permits an eligible premium add-on as an alternative to E5 for the analysed user.
claims.quote: Alternatively, users with an Office 365 E1 or an Office 365 or Microsoft 365 E3 license can be assigned a Microsoft Purview Suite (formerly known as Microsoft 365 E5 Compliance) or Microsoft 365 eDiscovery and Audit add-on license.

claims.where: Risks and limits: A case can lock itself
claims.claim: When a case's sole member leaves, users who are not Administrators cannot access it merely through Organization Management or eDiscovery Manager membership.
claims.quote: No one (including members of the Organization Management role group or another member of the eDiscovery Manager role group) can access that eDiscovery case because they aren't a member of a case.

claims.claim: Choose groups is the documented alternative to Choose users on Manage eDiscovery Manager.
claims.quote: On Manage eDiscovery Manager, select Choose users or Choose groups.
